source.notes: GET /sap/bc/adt/debugger/watchpoints immediately after the watchpoint hit captured in watchpoint-hit-step-continue. Answers 200 with the same <dbg:watchpoints> list shape as watchpoint-create-lv-total, but now oldValue is "0 " and currentValue is "1 " — the old-and-new-value pair for the LV_TOTAL watchpoint after its first hit. A near-identical GET at capture 912 (before the hit, currentValue still "0 ") is not turned into a separate cassette: it shares this exact method+path with no request body on either side, so a second cassette here would collide in the fake-route matcher (which keys GETs on method+path since there is no body to disambiguate on) — see generate-fake-routes.ts's cassetteRequestMatches. Redactions performed by the capture harness before this file was written: appliance host -> 203.0.113.10:50000 (RFC 5737), application-server hostname -> a4hsandbox, Authorization/Cookie/set-cookie header values stripped. sha256/byteLength in the source .meta.json are computed over the redacted body as stored.
